notes.title: Big Update No.1 to MPCC
notes.content:
[h2][h3][b]The MPCC beta testing has put the game on the correct path to release, with many new features being added to the game, and hundreds of bugs being patched.[/b][/h3][/h2]

The most recent update patched some bugs that caused the graphics and controls settings to be broken for new players.

The most recent build also added a short tutorial, still in the alpha phase, which should allow more players to enjoy the game.]

A leaderboard has been added, with players already setting very competitive scores.

The main game-modes are in development, such as the Car Chase, Battle Royale, Freeroam (Current mode), and many others.

Also created some dedicated servers, which are still a work in progress and are not always online.

[b]Join the [i]Discord Server[/i] with the link: https://discord.gg/BA5RU57jQc In order to report any updates[/b]

[b]Since the release, the major updates have included:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that breaks LODs
[*] Added lobby system
[*] Added Host system
[*] Added tutorial
[*] Added leaderboard
[*] Fixed buggy lights
[*] Expanded map
[*] Created new gun mechanics
[*] Improved graphics
[/list]

More huge updates are on the way, so stay tuned.

In the future, major updates will include new game-modes, cars, items, achievements and more.
